title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
“不好！”陈青云脸色狂变，立刻冲出了监控室，朝着女子摔落的地方奔去。上任第一天就弄出人命，那绝对是巨大的失职，哪怕杨副县长也帮不了他。“扑通！”陈青云脱掉外衣，纵身一跃，奋力朝着落水女子游去，抓住了她的玉臂。“啊！”女子下意识挣扎起来。“不要乱动，快抱住我！”陈青云用的是命令式的口气，不容置疑。女子这才反应过来，本能地搂住陈青云的脖子，仿佛他的怀抱是世上最安全的港湾。“好挺！”陈青云心中也是一荡，只觉得这具娇躯格外紧致。但他现在不敢乱想，一手搂住怀中佳人的纤腰，一手拼命划水，足足好几分钟，才终于游到岸上。“安全了，你没事吧？”陈青云关切问道，低头望向她的脸，瞬间惊为天人，只觉得心脏都漏跳了一拍。她不光身材曼妙，还拥有绝色容颜，鹅蛋脸，柳叶眉，杏眼樱唇，完全不亚于歌舞团台柱子江颜，甚至更胜一筹。简直是个无可挑剔的完美女人！“小伙子，谢谢你！”女子开口道谢。哪怕如此狼狈，但她依旧保持镇定，身上散发出一种高贵清冷的气质。“咦？你中毒了？”这时，陈青云却发现她嘴唇发黑，明显是中了蛇毒的迹象。“我的头好像有点晕，你能开车送我去医院么？”女子刚掏出钥匙，只觉得眼冒金星，摇摇欲坠，朝着地面栽去。陈青云立刻抱住了她。此刻，她浑身湿透，白色衬衫也变得半透明，甚至能看到里面的黑色罩罩，傲人酥胸也若隐若现。极致诱惑，令人忍不住想入非非。“咕咚！”陈青云吞了吞口水，强迫自己冷静下来：“美女，最近的县医院在十几公里外，都是山路，至少要开半小时！你恐怕坚持不到那儿，就会毒发身亡！”“你说什么？！”听到这话，女子十分意外，眼神中终于透出一丝慌乱。她刚从市里调到松山县，本就郁闷，想要来这水库散散心。没想到这么倒霉！想她今年才30岁，难道就要这么香消玉殒了么？

“美女，如果你信得过我，我可以替你把蛇毒吸出来！”陈青云开口提议。“真的？”女子面露狐疑之色，甚至怀疑陈青云是不是想要占便宜，才故意那么说。但很快，她又觉得浑身冰冷，眼前发黑，只能无奈点头：“好吧，那就让你试一试！”“你伤口在哪儿？”陈青云问道。“在那里！”女子红着脸，伸手指了指。陈青云顺势望了过去，发现竟然是在大腿根部。他救人心切，也没顾及那么多，直接脱掉她的外裤，露出两条修长浑圆的美腿。更要命的是，她穿的竟然是黑色蕾丝，还是情趣款。没想到在高贵的外表下，竟然如此闷骚。察觉到陈青云的目光，女子娇羞无比，美眸中透出几分小鹿乱撞般的慌乱。“抱歉，得罪了！”陈青云低下头，用嘴对准伤口，开始为她治疗起来。“唔唔唔……”女子只觉得娇躯一颤，犹如触电，哪怕咬紧银牙，但还是忍不住叫出声来。她实在没想到，自己可是市里无数人的梦中女神，却和一个县城的陌生小伙子，发生如此亲密的接触！但陈青云的嘴唇给她带来的感觉，却又欲罢不能。“好了，毒素应该吸的七七八八，暂时脱离危险了！”片刻后，陈青云长呼一口气，这才起身。女子则是香汗淋漓，艳若桃花，眼神迷离，似乎有些意犹未尽。“走，我开车送你医院！”陈青云用公主抱的方式，将她抱起来，走向远处的奥迪车。面对他的举动，女子非但不生气，心里甚至生出一丝暖意。这就是被人呵护的滋味吗？“今天真是太谢谢你了！我叫宁轻眉，不知道你怎么称呼？”宁轻眉问道。“陈青云！对了，你是市里人吧，这么晚怎么会一个人来水库？”“这个……我是调来松山县工作的！你又怎么会在这呢？”宁轻眉反问。陈青云苦笑一声：“我本来是唐志华县长的秘书，但得罪了人，被发配过来看水库了。”“哦。”宁轻眉眼神闪烁，若有所思，但也没有继续追问。……

"No!" Chen Qingyun's face changed wildly, and he immediately rushed out of the monitoring room and ran towards the place where the woman fell.It would definitely be a huge dereliction of duty to kill someone on the first day he took office. Even Deputy County Magistrate Yang couldn't help him."Plop!" Chen Qingyun took off his coat, jumped up, swam hard towards the woman who fell into the water, and grabbed her jade arm."Ah!" The woman struggled subconsciously."Don't move, hug me quickly!" Chen Qingyun used a commanding tone that left no room for doubt.Only then did the woman react and instinctively hugged Chen Qingyun's neck, as if his arms were the safest harbor in the world."It's so tight!" Chen Qingyun's heart also trembled, and he felt that this delicate body was particularly tight.But he didn't dare to think about it now. He put his arm around the slender waist of the beautiful woman in his arms and paddled desperately with the other hand. It took several minutes before he finally swam to the shore."It's safe, are you okay?" Chen Qingyun asked with concern, looking down at her face, he was so shocked that he felt his heart skip a beat.Not only does she have a graceful figure, but she also has a stunning face, with an oval face, willow-leaf eyebrows, almond eyes and cherry lips. She is no less beautiful than Jiang Yan, the mainstay of the song and dance troupe, or even better.What an impeccable and perfect woman!"Thank you, young man!" the woman said thanks.Even though she was so embarrassed, she still remained calm and exuded a noble and cold temperament."Eh? Are you poisoned?" At this time, Chen Qingyun found that her lips were black, which was an obvious sign of being poisoned by snake venom."My head seems a little dizzy, can you drive me to the hospital?" As soon as the woman took out the key, she felt like stars were in her eyes, and she was teetering on the verge of falling towards the ground.Chen Qingyun hugged her immediately.At this moment, she was soaked all over, and her white shirt had become translucent. You could even see the black bra underneath, and her proud breasts were also looming.The ultimate temptation, one can't help but have wild thoughts."Gudong!" Chen Qingyun swallowed and forced himself to calm down: "Beauty, the nearest county hospital is more than ten kilometers away on mountain roads. It takes at least half an hour to drive! I'm afraid you will die of poison if you don't make it there!" "What did you say?!" Upon hearing this, the woman was very surprised, and finally there was a trace of panic in her eyes.She had just been transferred to Songshan County from the city. She was already depressed and wanted to come to this reservoir to relax.I didn't expect to be so unlucky!I think she is only 30 years old this year, is she going to die like this?

"Beauty, if you trust me, I can suck out the snake venom for you!" Chen Qingyun suggested."Really?" The woman looked suspicious, even wondering if Chen Qingyun wanted to take advantage of him and said that deliberately.But soon, she felt cold all over her body and her eyes turned black. She could only nod helplessly: "Okay, let me give you a try!" "Where is your wound?" Chen Qingyun asked."There!" The woman blushed and pointed.Chen Qingyun looked over and found that it was at the root of his thigh.He was so eager to save people that he didn't take her pants off, revealing her two slender and round legs.What's even worse is that she is wearing black lace, which is also a sexy style.I didn't expect that under the noble appearance, he could be so sultry.Sensing Chen Qingyun's gaze, the woman was extremely shy, and there was a bit of panic like a deer in her beautiful eyes."Sorry, I'm offended!" Chen Qingyun lowered his head, pointed his mouth at the wound, and began to treat her."Uh huh..." The woman only felt her delicate body tremble, like an electric shock. Even though she clenched her teeth, she still couldn't help but scream.She really didn't expect that she, the dream goddess of countless people in the city, would have such close contact with a strange young man from the county town!But the feeling that Chen Qingyun's lips brought to her was something she couldn't stop."Okay, the toxins should be sucked out, and we are out of danger for the time being!" After a while, Chen Qingyun took a long breath and stood up.The woman was dripping with sweat, as gorgeous as a peach blossom, her eyes were blurred, and she seemed to have some unfinished thoughts."Let's go, I'll drive you to the hospital!" Chen Qingyun picked her up like a princess and walked towards the Audi car in the distance.Facing his actions, the woman not only wasn't angry, she even felt a little warm in her heart.Is this what it feels like to be cared for?"Thank you so much today! My name is Ning Qingmei, I wonder what you call me?" Ning Qingmei asked."Chen Qingyun! By the way, you are from the city, right? Why are you coming to the reservoir alone so late?" "Well... I was transferred to work in Songshan County! Why are you here?" Ning Qingmei asked.Chen Qingyun smiled bitterly: "I was originally the secretary of County Magistrate Tang Zhihua, but I offended someone and was sent to look at the reservoir." "Oh." Ning's eyebrows flickered, thoughtful, but he did not continue to ask.…
